_doc: 3D models of the cards, shown by the standalone preview (index.html?anim3d). cards: card id -> model. type gltf: path to a .glb / .gltf file. type script: path to a .js file and the name of the builder it registers (CardModelScripts[builder] = (THREE, params) => Object3D). A path is relative to this folder unless it starts with assets/. Optional: scale, offset [x,y,z], rotationDeg [x,y,z], select (the animation clip played when the card is selected; else a clip whose name contains 'select'; else a procedural one). byConvention: true = a card with no entry tries <id>.glb in this folder. A card without a model shows a placeholder. See Docs/ANIMATION_3D.md
